back:
Program state is the state of an executing program at a point in time. It represents a combination of information, which is tracked during the execution of a program, at a point in time. 

This information includes the variables you’re using, which functions have been called (so that when those functions return, the program will know where to go back to), and the current point of execution within the program (so it knows which statement to execute next).
